evidence.name: UpdateVariableGadgetValues
support: Complete body contains 518 instructions/2452 bytes, all inspected. Direct caller 140ab4b50 masks object header type to seven bits and dispatches type 0x58 through table 1416b56d0 index 0x57 to branch 140ab7f63, passing the VariableGadget object in RSI at call 140ab7f7e.

The function gates five-float initialization on VariableValueShouldBePreserved+0x10f, broadcasts InitialValue+0xe8 to +0xf4 through +0x104, applies lower/upper limits, and processes linked type-0x59 VariableModifierGadget objects.

Modifier field +0x118 is OperationType, registered by 140d68c70 and matched to directly read enum literals in 140ca9f10: 0 Set, 1 Get, 2 Add, 3 Reset. Assembly performs replacement/addition/InitialValue restoration for 0/2/3; Get produces no write in these branches.

The tail constructs strict ordered increase/decrease masks at +0x10b/+0x10c: bits0..3 correspond to the four player floats +0xf8..+0x104; bit4 corresponds to non-player +0xf4. Missing comparison object exits without updating the masks.

evidence.name: SortU16IndicesByDescendingI32Keys
support: Complete cached body and all 478 assembly instructions reviewed. The routine rearranges unsigned 16-bit indices using signed 32-bit keys through an external key-array pointer.
Signed JG/JLE comparisons in pivot selection, partitioning, heap fallback and insertion establish descending key order.
All 1735 recognized instruction bytes audited; 84 direct branch targets present; 15 listing gaps follow unconditional jumps and are not fallthrough gaps.
Both external callers are in the game merge routine. The caller initializes consecutive U16 indices and supplies the address of its key-array pointer.
The insertion-path call resolves through the local loader NID +P6FRGH4LfA; shadPS4 primary registration source identifies memmove, matching the observed overlapping two-byte right shift.
